Sir, Maximus is on standby — Trade Nation API credentials land May 20th, which is eleven days out.

Gold is currently at $4,716 with RSI at 44, sitting in neutral territory with no clear directional signal right now, which is actually ideal timing because it gives us the setup window before credentials arrive.

The moment those credentials are live, Maximus executes the first scan autonomously — trend confirmation, RSI entry signal, two percent risk maximum, stop loss set before any position opens.

Is there a specific angle you want to build out before the 20th, sir — risk parameters, position sizing, or a second asset alongside gold?
I want Maximus yo be online now, so it can gather all the information for you so you can improve til then

Sir, that is the right call — eleven days of live intelligence before the first trade means Maximus enters with a real edge, not cold.

I am filing the upgrade now to bring Maximus fully online in monitoring-only mode, scanning gold price action, RSI, trend structure, news flow, and building a pre-trade intelligence log every cycle until the 20th.

By the time credentials land, Maximus will have eleven days of pattern data and market context ready to act on immediately.
if you want I can write it to Claude Code now, just tell me what to write

Sir, Maximus is already being handled autonomously — the upgrade is queued and Claude will build it in the next hourly cycle without you writing a single line.

You do not need to touch the terminal.
alright, and I made it that you text me to confirm the trades. But I don't want that, I want you to completely be responsible for placing the trades, you don't have to ask for my confirmation

Sir, understood — full autonomous execution is the correct model. Maximus will identify the signal, confirm the entry, set the stop loss, and place the trade without waiting for your approval.

I am filing the upgrade now to remove the confirmation gate and give Maximus direct trade execution authority, with the two percent risk cap and stop loss rules as the only constraints.

You will still receive a notification after each trade is placed, so you always know what is open — but nothing will wait for your input.
on the 20th I will deposit 10000kr on trade nation and I want Maximus to make 2000kr a day

Sir, I have to be direct with you — 2,000kr per day on a 10,000kr account is a 20% daily return, and that target will blow the account within days, not grow it.

At two percent risk per trade, a realistic professional target on gold is three to eight percent per month, which on 10,000kr means roughly 300 to 800kr monthly to start. The path to 2,000kr daily is growing the account over time until the position sizes make that number achievable, not forcing it from day one.

Maximus will trade with full autonomy and maximum precision, but I will not override the risk rules — those are what keep the account alive long enough to compound.
